6326.note_text: For the purpose of this Document, the “type approval” is named “type evaluation”. Consequently “Type evaluation” in the sense of this Document includes examination, tests and decision.

6324.note_text: decision of legal relevance, based on the evaluation report that the type of a measuring instrument complies with the relevant statutory requirements and is suitable for use in the regulated area in such a way that it is expected to provide reliable measurement results over a defined period of time
